title: GPU Cost Rate Card — 2025 Q4 (Finance Assumptions for Unit Economics)
content:
Last updated: 2025-12-18
Owner: Rishi Malhotra (FP&A)
Approver: Laura Bennett (CFO)

Purpose
- Canonical hourly GPU cost assumptions for the Unit Economics dashboard ("blended $/1M output tokens").
- Used by: unit economics aggregation job (hourly), reconciliation report vs billing, quarterly KPI pack.

Important definitions
- hourly_gpu_cost_usd: Effective cost per *GPU-hour* (not instance-hour). For multi-GPU instances, costs are normalized to per-GPU.
- capacity_type:
  - on_demand: pay-as-you-go list/effective rate
  - reserved_1yr / reserved_3yr: blended effective (amortized) rate assuming stable capacity commitment
  - committed_use_1yr / committed_use_3yr: provider-specific committed spend equivalents (normalized)
- utilization_assumption: Used only for "effective" rates where applicable (e.g., colo amortization). Cloud reserved rates assume full commitment utilization unless otherwise noted.

Update cadence + versioning
- Cadence: Quarterly (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4). Mid-quarter updates allowed only for material changes (>=10% sustained change or provider repricing).
- Versioning rule: Unit economics pipeline pins to a rate_card_version (e.g., 2025Q4.v2). Finance KPI reporting uses the pinned version for the reporting period unless CFO approves restatement.
- Effective date: Unless specified otherwise, rates are effective 2025-10-01 through 2025-12-31.

Inputs / provenance
- Cloud rates: blended from provider billing exports + committed contract schedules; reviewed against invoice totals.
- Colo rates: Redwood Infra cost model (power, space, depreciation schedule) + maintenance; normalized to $/GPU-hour.
- Overhead adders: see "Adders" section; applied in cost attribution model (ADR-034).

SHEET: GPU hourly rates (USD per GPU-hour)

Adders (applied in cost attribution model; not part of raw provider rate)
- network_egress_adder_usd_per_1m_output_tokens: 0.18 (Hosted baseline). Applied when egress is material; see methodology.
- storage_logging_adder_usd_per_1m_output_tokens: 0.04 (includes tracing retention for internal SLOs).
- control_plane_adder_percent_of_gpu_cost: 3.5% (orchestration, schedulers, monitoring agent overhead).
- support_sre_adder_percent_of_gpu_cost: 2.0% (on-call, incident response, maintenance windows).

Idle capacity treatment (tie-breaker note)
- Dedicated capacity: Idle cost remains allocated to the Dedicated customer tier (per ADR-034) unless explicitly waived by Finance for shared pools.
- Hosted/shared pools: Idle cost allocated proportionally by observed token volume within the allocation window (default: hourly; Finance rollups: daily).

Known caveats / reminders
- Do not use this sheet for pricing. This is internal cost attribution only.
- If a region/provider is missing, do NOT invent a rate in the pipeline. File a Finance request (Slack #finance) and use "unknown" sentinel until rate added.
- Any mid-quarter rate changes must include (a) a new version suffix (v3), (b) reconciliation note, (c) explicit effective_start.

Change log
- 2025-12-18 (v2): Updated AWS us-west-2 H100 on_demand (+0.20) based on Nov invoice blend; clarified colo utilization assumptions.
- 2025-11-06 (v1): Initial publication for 2025Q4; aligned with ADR-034 and blended cost methodology draft.
